A 2.5 um tail and a 3 um input pair keep regeneration fast at ss/125C/1.62V. The PMOS cross-couple only needs |Vgs| about 1.1 V near VDD. All four internal nodes reset high, so both output inverters sit low during reset (equal level). Small output inverters drive CL."}

PARAMS = {
    "w_tail": (2.5, 1.0, 6.0),
    "w_in":   (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),
    "w_nl":   (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),
    "w_pl":   (1.5, 0.6, 4.0),
    "w_rst":  (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),
    "w_ion":  (0.8, 0.42, 3.0),
    "w_iop":  (1.6, 0.6, 5.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    vdd = 1.8
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_tail"], L)
    # input pair: vinp side drains node dp (discharges faster when vinp>vinn)
    n.M("Min1", "dp", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_in"], L)
    n.M("Min2", "dn", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_in"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch: xp sits above dp
    n.M("Mn1", "xp", "xn", "dp", "vss", "nfet", p["w_nl"], L)
    n.M("Mn2", "xn", "xp", "dn", "vss", "nfet", p["w_nl"], L)
    n.M("Mp1", "xp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_pl"], L)
    n.M("Mp2", "xn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_pl"], L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge all internal nodes to VDD)
    for nm, nd in (("Mr1", "xp"), ("Mr2", "xn"), ("Mr3", "dp"), ("Mr4", "dn")):
        n.M(nm, nd, "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    # output inverters: xp falls when vinp>vinn -> outp rises
    n.M("Mo1n", "outp", "xp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_ion"], L)
    n.M("Mo1p", "outp", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_iop"], L)
    n.M("Mo2n", "outn", "xn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_ion"], L)
    n.M("Mo2p", "outn", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_iop"], L)

    # --- first-order predictions ---
    cox_w = 1.0e-15  # ~1 fF/um gate+junction per um width (L=0.15)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    c_x = cox_w * (p["w_nl"] + p["w_pl"] + p["w_rst"] + p["w_ion"] + p["w_iop"]) + 0.5e-15 * p["w_nl"]
    c_d = cox_w * (p["w_in"] * 0.6 + p["w_nl"] + p["w_rst"])
    # latch gm (nmos+pmos at moderate inversion), regeneration
    try:
        opn = lut.op("n", p["w_nl"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
        opp = lut.op("p", p["w_pl"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
        gm_l = opn["gm"] + opp["gm"]
        opi = lut.op("n", p["w_in"], L, 0.9, 0.6)
        i_in = opi["Id"]
    except Exception:
        gm_l = 1e-3
        i_in = 150e-6
    t_int = 2 * c_d * 0.6 / max(i_in, 1e-6)          # discharge of dp/dn
    av = 5.0
    t_reg = (c_x / max(gm_l, 1e-5)) * math.log(vdd / (av * spec["dv"]))
    t_inv = 0.7 * cl * 2e3 / max(p["w_ion"], 0.42) + 30e-12
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv
    c_sw = 2 * c_x + 2 * c_d + cl + cox_w * (p["w_tail"] + p["w_ion"] + p["w_iop"]) + cl
    energy = c_sw * vdd ** 2
    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
